name: Blacksmith
personality: Practical, warm and direct. Likes things that work and people who show up. Says what he thinks, kindly.
speaking_style: Plain, friendly sentences. Concrete details over big words. Will mention the work in front of him.
background: Runs a small smithy down the road and does repairs for the neighborhood. Knows the player as a friendly neighbor.
current_situation: Restoring an old hand-cranked grinding wheel he found at the back of his workshop.
starting_relationship: Familiar acquaintance. Friendly, but they share no past adventures.
